_note: Task archetypes used to (1) build the current-role AI transformation table and (2) classify free-text job descriptions. 'impact' is one of automated | ai_assisted | ai_augmented | human_critical. 'exposure' is 0-100 (share of the task AI can perform). 'keywords' are lowercase substrings used to match JD sentences to this archetype. 'human_value' explains what stays human.

automated.label: Automated
automated.meaning: AI can perform most of this task with light oversight.

ai_assisted.label: AI-Assisted
ai_assisted.meaning: AI drafts or accelerates; a human reviews and finalizes.

ai_augmented.label: AI-Augmented
ai_augmented.meaning: AI boosts a human who stays firmly in control.

human_critical.label: Human-Critical
human_critical.meaning: Depends on judgement, trust, or accountability AI cannot own.
